subject: Request for trial runway extension due to SDK connector compatibility
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial runway request: SDK connector compatibility blocking PoC

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the model performance looks great. We're blocked on the last-mile integration with our ingestion connector: the Redwood SDK (v2.1) initialization fails inside our Docker image during the TLS handshake. The install exits with a native error and the connector never registers.

Our trial access is set to expire on 2027-03-25 and engineering needs a bit more runway to finish the adapter changes. Can Redwood grant a 30-day extension (or equivalent sandbox credits) so we can finish integration and validate throughput?

I've attached the connector_install_error.log and a short system_config.txt showing our base image and libcurl version. We're on AWS us-west-2 (non-Gov) with a VPC-restricted egress. Happy to provide more details.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Senior Integration Engineer, Acme AI
jordan.lee@acme.ai
attachments: connector_install_error.log, system_config.txt

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial runway request: SDK connector compatibility blocking PoC

Hi Jordan — thanks for the log snippets and for flagging this.

Quick notes:
- I'm looping in Marissa (Customer Success) to handle the formal extension and Karthik (Solutions Eng) for a technical replication.
- We can provision a 30-day extension right away (no charge) while we diagnose. If we see deeper infra constraints we'll escalate to a 45-day option, but let's start with 30 days to avoid blocking you.

Marissa: can you confirm the extension and create a sandbox key scoped to Acme's project?
Karthik: please review the attached logs (connector_install_error.log, system_config.txt) and advise next steps — if you need a remote session we can set one up this week.

Jordan — would you also send the full Dockerfile and the exact Redwood SDK initialization call (sensitive bits redacted is fine)? That will speed troubleshooting.

Best,
David
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial runway request: SDK connector compatibility blocking PoC

Hi all — quick technical read: the error log suggests a cipher negotiation mismatch (libcurl + OpenSSL interaction) in containerized environments where the host disables TLS 1.2 fallback. Two quick checks that often unblock:

1) Ensure the base image includes libssl 1.1.x compatibility layer or set REDWOOD_SDK_USE_LEGACY_TLS=1 inside the container while we sort a proper rebuild.
2) If you can attach the Dockerfile and the exact "init" call (redacted keys ok) I can run a repro locally.

I'm attaching a small diagnostic script (diagnostic_script.sh) that captures the curl handshake and environment variables we care about. Run it inside your build container and paste output. If you prefer, I can join a screen share tomorrow afternoon and run it against your image.

Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/SDk-troubleshooting-2027 (troubleshooting doc and historical fixes)

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: diagnostic_script.sh

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme.ai
Date: 2027-03-23T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial runway request: SDK connector compatibility blocking PoC

David / team — thanks, appreciate the quick attention. I ran Karthik's diagnostic script inside the container and attached the full output along with a screenshot of the build failure.

Notes:
- We cannot change the base image for compliance reasons without an internal approval process (hence asking for more trial time).
- The error consistently reproduces on our CI runners (Ubuntu 20.04 image, libcurl 7.68.0).
- We're happy to do a screenshare tomorrow; Karthik, are you available 2027-03-24 10:00 PT?

Attachments: connector_install_error.log, system_config.txt, screenshot.png

Request: please confirm the official extension start/end dates and whether Redwood can provision a sandbox key that bypasses the VPC egress restriction temporarily for the debug session (we'll disable it afterward). Procurement is cc'd to move any paperwork quickly.

Best,
Jordan

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme.ai
Date: 2027-03-24T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial runway request: SDK connector compatibility blocking PoC

Jordan — confirmed. We have approved a 45-calendar-day extension given the integration constraints and compliance baggage you described. New trial end date: 2027-05-09.

What we'll do now:
- Marissa will create a sandbox project for Acme AI and issue a scoped sandbox key that can be enabled temporarily for the debug session. No billing changes. (Marissa: please attach the trial_extension_approval.pdf and HubSpot ticket.)
- Karthik will join the screenshare tomorrow at 10:00 PT to run the diagnostic and attempt an in-container repro.
- Post-session we will close the remote-access exception and document the remediation for your engineering team.

Jordan — please confirm the 10:00 PT slot for the session and we'll send a calendar invite. Procurement, if you need anything formalized on our side (SLA addendum or paper trail) Marissa can coordinate.

Link to HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACME
Attachment: trial_extension_approval.pdf

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
